limitations: A hearing transcript preserves participants’ testimony and memories rather than independently settled findings.
Image attachments were not opened; descriptions rely on spoken testimony and textual captions.
Temperature and timing discrepancies are retained with attribution or cautious magnitude statements rather than silently unified.
Not a word-for-word translation; repeated exchanges and incidental details condensed while retaining major topics, evidence, limitations and disagreement.
No human reading feedback; self-review is not evidence of reader engagement.
